info.title: Diskograf API
info.description:
A public, read-only REST API over the Diskograf catalogue of Malaysian music.

Public endpoints require no authentication and expose only published
catalogue rows. Requests are rate limited to 360 per 60 seconds per IP address.

The `/v1/admin` endpoints are the exception: authenticated with a short-lived
bearer token minted by diskograf.com for Backstage staff. They bypass API
rate limits and are never cached because they expose unpublished rows.

The `/v1/me` endpoints are the signed-in user's own private rows. They use a
separate notification-api (notification feed) or editor-api (song-editor
helpers) token, derive the account from its subject and are never cached,
including their error responses.

Every successful response is wrapped in an envelope. List endpoints return
`{ "data": [...], "meta": { "total", "limit", "offset", "next_cursor" } }`; detail endpoints
return `{ "data": {...} }`. Errors return `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`.

post.description: Calls YouTube, Spotify and Apple Music for the song's stored links, writes the snapshots, and has apps/web purge the song's provider-stat cache tags. Each provider reports its own status, so one missing snapshot never fails the other two. YouTube calls draw from a shared daily budget; once it is spent the stored YouTube snapshot is replayed as `stale` and the other two providers continue. Callable only from diskograf.com (Origin/Referer checked). Fails closed (503) when the cache callback is not provisioned.

200.description: One status per provider; `data` is present only on `ok`, and `from` marks a replayed snapshot (`cache` inside the 3h TTL, `stale` after a provider failure or an exhausted daily YouTube budget).

get.summary: Suggest an official music video for a song (backstage)
get.description: Authenticated, admin-only, read-scoped. Suggests the song's official music video when its current YouTube video is an official audio, visualizer or lyric video tied to the current video id. Searches YouTube and judges the results with TypeSafe (Jev), requiring both a same-song and an official-music-video answer above the route's threshold. The verdict is cached per song and source video id for 24 hours in the shared Upstash store — including an explicit no-match, so reopening the page cannot spend YouTube quota again; a YouTube or Jev failure caches nothing. Answers `status: "ineligible"` without any search when the current video cannot be replaced this way. 502 when YouTube or the classifier fails, 503 when `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`, `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` or `REDIS_URL` is unset.
